description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job. As Electric Propulsion Test Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit's own vacuum facilities. You work shoulder to shoulder with our propulsion engineers. You build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design. Responsibilities Plan and build Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries. Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing. Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities. Test and analyse Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests. Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results. Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last. Verify and document Keep clear records of every test configuration and result, giving traceable evidence for system verification and qualification. Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers to integrate and test each new iteration of the ion propulsion system. Requirements Essential Practical electric propulsion testing experience, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances. Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition systems. Working knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters and of plasma physics, diagnostics and ionisation processes. A rigorous approach to test planning, data quality and documentation. Willingness to work extended hours on-site. Nice to have Experience with plasma diagnostics such as Langmuir probes or retarding potential analysers. Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB). Experience with test rig design or hardware verification for flight programmes. We are recruiting across propulsion design and test. Apply to whichever role fits you best - strong candidates may be considered for either. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Global expansion is broken. Without a local entity, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it.

Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it or expand slowly and expensively.

Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. Pick only what you need (tax, payments, treasury, or operations) and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we act as Merchant of Record, taking on tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.

Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise.

🧠 The Role

At Outpost, Operations means problem-solving at scale. We tackle the company's toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. We design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a junior generalist to work inside that engine. You'll be attached to real initiatives across the business - product, onboarding, market launches, finance, GTM - and you'll own concrete pieces of them end to end. Not shadowing, not note-taking: workstreams with your name on them, from day one.

This is a generalist role. You'll value breadth over depth. One week you're cleaning and modelling market data, the next you're running the checklist for a country launch, the week after you're sitting in merchant calls and turning what you heard into a product requirement. If you want to stay in one lane, this isn't for you.

You'll work directly with the founding team. If you're hungry, you'll compress years of learning into months. Most people wait a decade for this proximity. You'll have it in week one.

🧩 What You'll Do

Product

  • Sit close to merchants and the market, and feed what you learn back into the product roadmap

  • Help scope features: gather the pain points, size the opportunity, write the first draft of the spec

  • Track product performance and competitive positioning, and keep the team honest with numbers

Operations & GTM

  • Run and improve processes across onboarding, compliance, and merchant operations

  • Support new market launches: own the checklist of legal, tax, payments, and operational steps and drive it to done

  • Join customer conversations, prepare the materials, chase the follow-ups that keep deals moving

  • Write the playbooks and documentation that let us scale without adding headcount

Finance & Strategy

  • Build and maintain the models behind unit economics, pricing, and market planning

  • Keep KPI tracking and reporting clean, current, and trusted

  • Support the prep for investor updates and board materials

💥 Example Projects

  • Build the first-draft financial model for a new market entry: entity costs, tax rates, payback period

  • Run a merchant through onboarding end to end, document every friction point, and propose the fix

  • Turn our EU VAT compliance steps into a playbook anyone on the team can execute

  • Track and analyse competitive positioning against other MoR platforms, and keep the battle card current

  • Debug a delayed payout across engineering, ops, and compliance, and write up the fix so it never happens twice

  • Take a manual weekly process, automate it with scripts or no-code, and retire it

🧱 What We're Looking For

Ideal background:

  • 0-2 years of experience, or exceptional straight out of university

  • Internships or a first role in high-growth fintech or tech, consulting, banking, or a startup of any kind

  • STEM or quantitative degree preferred, but not required if you can demonstrate analytical horsepower

  • Evidence you've built, run, or fixed something real: a project, a business, a system, an analysis

Signals we care about:

  • Ridiculous bias for action: you solve, not observe

  • Analytically strong: comfortable in a spreadsheet, curious about SQL, allergic to unquantified claims

  • AI-native by instinct: you reach for Claude, scripts, and no-code to do in an hour what takes a day, and you can tell good output from plausible rubbish

  • Precise: in this business a mistake can go to a regulator or a merchant. You check your work before anyone asks

  • Strong EQ: you know how to read a room, a customer, or a blocker

  • Exceptionally hard working: you see work as a core part of your purpose

  • Fluent in ambiguity and chaos: startups are not neat, this will be hard

  • Curious and resourceful: you can figure anything out

  • Clear, quantified achievements on your CV (not vague descriptions)

What this role is not:

  • Not an internship where you watch: you'll carry real workstreams with real deadlines

  • Not a single-function track: you won't specialise in year one, by design

  • Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective. You'll often be building the process

🚀 Why This Role Is Different

Most junior roles teach you one function inside a machine someone else built. This one puts you inside the room where the machine is being built, across every part of the business: product, finance, GTM, operations.

You'll work directly with a founding team that has done this at scale before. You'll ship things that matter in your first month. And the ceiling is real: we expect whoever takes this role to grow fast, and we'll back you every step of the way.

🧾 What We Offer

  • Ability to own your work and move fast

  • World-class training from operators who've scaled globally

  • A global mission with real impact

  • Low politics, high output

  • A culture of builders, not talkers

🧭 Working Style

We work together in person in London. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.

🌎 How to apply

No cover letter. Send us: (1) something you built, with a link; (2) one line on which of the six areas you'd automate first, and how; (3) bonus - pull a public dataset or feed and send a one-screen dashboard.

Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.

Spire Global is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Satellite Developer Experience (SatDevEx) team to create and expand a software build, test, and deployment framework befitting one of the world's largest and most dynamic satellite constellations. 

 

About SatDevEx:

 

The SatDevEx team build and maintain the tools and infrastructure that make satellite software development at Spire faster, safer, and more enjoyable. Our products benefit our fellow engineers while unlocking considerable potential in support of wider company initiatives and customer projects.

 

What You'll Work On: 

  • You'll collaborate with a highly skilled, multidisciplinary engineering organization to: 
  • Design and maintain advanced testing frameworks—supporting both virtual and bare-metal hardware environments—for internal teams and external customers. 
  • Build and enhance an automated software update pipeline for satellites in orbit. 
  • Identify and eliminate friction points in the satellite software development lifecycle with smart, user-friendly tools and workflows. 
  • Architect and implement the next-generation satellite software framework to support highly resilient and high-performance space systems. 

 

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Broad Impact: Your work will support dozens of developers across Spire, directly improving satellite software quality and delivery speed. 
  • Technical Breadth and Depth: From embedded systems to GitOps pipelines, you'll be exposed to a wide technical spectrum.
  • Team Autonomy: You'll be part of a small, self-directed team with the resources and support of a 150+ person engineering organization. 
  • Culture of Automation: We embrace CI/CD, extensive test coverage, and a GitOps-based delivery model, freeing you to focus on solving meaningful problems.

 

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience and interest in building infrastructure or tools that support developer productivity. 
  • Strong coding skills and familiarity with testing and observation strategies. 
  • Passion for automation, reliability, scalability, and elegant tooling. 
  • Comfort navigating complex systems, quickly learning and navigating new arenas of code, and collaborating across functions (e.g., software researchers, embedded developers, satellite operators). 
  • Willingness to provide emergency operational support, fix bugs and maintain existing code.

Desired Skills/Experience:

  • 4+ years of working experience in software engineering 
  • Computer science degree or equivalent work experience; experience in the full lifecycle of a software.
  • Software programming experience and proficiency in at least one of: Rust, Python
  • Proficiency in Linux/Unix, Git, Docker and Shell Scripting 
  • Familiarity with PaaS, IaC, Cloud and CI tools. Examples include AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Github Actions, PostgreSQL, Hashicorp Vault, Grafana, Databricks. 

Spire operates a hybrid work model, and this position will require you to work a minimum of three business days per week in the office.

Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. #LI-MK1

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance

👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Search (remote, Europe)
raw.description:
Hey, I'm Adrian. I’m hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join the Data Search team at Modash.

Modash helps brands find, understand, and work with creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. More than 2,700 companies—including Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN—use us to manage and scale their creator partnerships.

Behind that product is a fascinating search problem: helping customers find the right people across 400M+ creator profiles and billions of media files. We’re combining large-scale data processing, traditional retrieval, vector search, multimodal embeddings, and LLMs to make that possible.

That’s where you come in.

Why we're hiring

Search at Modash isn't an internal platform or a support function. It is one of the core products customers use to discover creators.

The scale is large, the data is messy, and the search intent is often complex. A customer might be looking for creators in a specific niche, people whose content conveys a certain visual style, or accounts that resemble a group they already know. Solving that well requires more than adding another filter or calling an LLM API.

We need a senior engineer who can work across the full retrieval system—from data and indexing pipelines to embeddings, ranking, relevance, and low-latency serving—and take ambiguous product problems all the way to production.

You’ll join the specialised Data Search team and work closely with Data Core, Data Insights, product teams, customers, and company leadership. You’ll have real autonomy, but you won’t work in isolation.

If you want a feel for how we think about building software, check our Engineering Blog.

What you'll actually own

1. Make creator search meaningfully better.

You’ll improve how customers discover creators across 400M+ profiles and billions of media files. That includes retrieval, filtering, ranking, relevance, speed, and the product decisions that connect them.

2. Turn multimodal data into searchable intelligence.

You’ll build systems that generate and use embeddings from images, video, text, and audio at massive scale—then make those signals useful in a real customer-facing search experience.

3. Ship new search capabilities into production.

You’ll evaluate models and technologies pragmatically, understand tradeoffs around cost, latency, and quality, and move promising approaches from experiment to a reliable production system within weeks rather than quarters.

4. Own the system end to end.

You’ll help shape the problem, gather requirements, design the architecture, write the code, release it, measure the outcome, and improve it. Senior engineers here own results, not just implementation tasks.

What the day-to-day looks like

Here’s what a typical week might include:

  • Monday. A customer search is returning technically relevant but unhelpful results. You inspect the retrieval and ranking stages, identify where intent is being lost, and propose a measurable improvement.
  • Tuesday. Deep-focus time. You build a pipeline to generate multimodal embeddings across a large batch of creator content and test how the new representation affects retrieval quality and cost.
  • Wednesday. You work with Data Insights on a new in-house datapoint. Together, you agree on its definition, coverage, and data-quality requirements, then expose it in Search to give customers more ways to discover creators.
  • Thursday. You test a reranking model on a fixed set of real customer queries. You measure how much it improves relevance against the latency and inference cost it adds, then decide what's ready for production.
  • Friday. You review production metrics, investigate a relevance regression, and share what you learned with the team. The fix may be in the model, the data, the query logic, or the product itself—you follow the evidence.

We keep meetings purposeful and protect time for deep work. You’ll have a short standup, close collaboration when it helps, and plenty of space to design, build, optimise, and launch.

Requirements

What you've done before

  • Built large-scale data or backend products. You have solid experience working with systems where volume, latency, reliability, and cost all matter.
  • Shipped products from concept to production. You’ve owned scoping, architecture, implementation, release, measurement, and iteration—not just one layer of the solution.
  • Designed distributed systems. You can reason clearly about throughput, failure modes, data flow, scalability, and operational tradeoffs.
  • Built LLM-powered or agentic features in production. You understand the practical differences between models and can balance capability against latency and cost.
  • Worked autonomously on ambiguous problems. You know how to gather requirements, ask useful questions, and turn incomplete context into forward motion.
  • Communicated clearly across teams. You can explain technical tradeoffs to engineers and non-engineers, give direct feedback, and collaborate without creating unnecessary process.
  • Worked in a fast-moving product environment. You’re comfortable learning quickly, shipping incrementally, and changing direction when the evidence does.

Bonus points if you’ve worked with multimodal embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, ranking algorithms, model deployment, self-hosted models, or GPU infrastructure. Curiosity about the creator economy helps too, but we’ll get you up to speed.

Our stack

  • AWS and GCP, with Pulumi for infrastructure as code
  • Python, TypeScript, and Node.js
  • PySpark on AWS EMR
  • Airflow
  • Milvus Vector DB through Zilliz
  • Elasticsearch
  • LLM batch APIs
  • Apache Iceberg
  • SageMaker, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Kinesis, Lambda, ECS, and Aurora
  • Slack, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and Cursor

The interview process

We move quickly and can complete the process in under a week:

  1. Intro chat
  2. Coding interview
  3. System design interview
  4. Team interview
  5. Culture and alignment conversation with our CEO, Avery Schrader

Benefits

What we offer

  • Fully remote in Europe 🏠 Work from wherever you do your best work, with some overlap with GMT+3.
  • Compensation. Your compensation is made up of salary and stock options. As we're growing fast, the stock option package is especially significant. Annual salary range is 100,000€ - 130,000€ for this role. We hire across Europe, so the exact number depends on your location, employment type, skills, and experience.
  • Flexible hours ⏱ We care about outcomes, not when you log on.
  • Unlimited paid vacation 🌴 If you’re rested and happy, you do better work. Take what you need.
  • Personal development support 🧠 Courses, books, and conferences are on us when they help you grow.
  • Real ownership 💡 Take difficult search problems from idea to production without layers of unnecessary process.
  • Regular offsites ✈️ We’re remote-first, but we make time to connect, collaborate, and have fun together in person.

And a little more about us...

Founded in 2018 by a high-school dropout and a Canadian (yes, we’re also shocked it’s going so well), Modash is building a suite of tools that help brands scale partnerships with online content creators.

2,700+ companies like Stanley 1913, Sennheiser, and NordVPN already use Modash to manage and scale their influencer marketing work. And we're just getting started. Over the coming decade, brand investment in creators will continue to boom, and Modash will be at the centre of it all.

Modash is here to stay. We have 8-figures in ARR across two products, a $12M series A investment, and we are default alive. We are building a company that will still be here in 20 years; not rushing towards an exit.

We’re almost 100 people distributed across 20+ countries, operating with a fast, async-first culture. If you join Modash, you’ll be surrounded by people who truly want to be the greatest at their craft. People who make you better. Interesting people too, who have done everything from building solar cars, to hanging out with Metallica and Bon Jovi.

Come join us. Be great, do great things, create great memories, all while making a great impact. Do it.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

We want you as a talented Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer to contribute to the development, testing, analysis, prediction and refinement of the functional architecture for Nyx Earth Propulsion System Development Models.

In order to derisk and gain confidence on the flight propulsion system, different development models are being built in order to run a multitude of tests spanning from functional tests, cold flows to system level hot fires. This testing will allow for the verification and validation of all the propulsion subsystems. You will be responsible for bridging the gap between design and hardware testing for the Nyx spacecraft propulsion system. As such, you will work closely with both the design and testing teams to ensure seamless integration and validation of propulsion subsystems.

You will report to the Propulsion Development Models Principal Engineer.

Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a Propulsion Functional Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for the development of analysis, post processing, and prediction tools that can support testing and design activities linked to the propulsion sub-systems.

  • Support on the creation of test plans for propulsion subsystems (from a modeling perspective), including data acquisition, analysis, and reporting to ensure the performance of the system can be assessed.

  • Design and develop propulsion analysis and post processing tools, to support testing activities and design maturation

  • Work in close collaboration with the pressure and feed system engineers to ensure the anchoring of the different fluidic models and assess against test data

During testing phase:

  • Provide on-site support during propulsion test campaigns, working closely with the test operator and test conductor.

  • Perform test campaigns, analysing in real-time, through different test parameters and ensure test results with timely resolution of any anomaly arising during testing.

  • Conduct pre-test and post-test reviews and elaborate the test reports.

  • Update and correlate the fluidic models based on test results.

  • Provide actionable insights to identify key performance indicators and potential critical scenarios

What we would love to see from you:

  • A minimum of a bachelor's degree in a related Engineering discipline.

  • +3 years of related experience in complex fluid systems, fluidic modeling, data analysis and data post processing.

raw.title: Managing Director - France
raw.description:
Location: France

Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations

Note: This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.

About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best, building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.

Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 10 countries, and growing.

The Role

As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.

You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision & Growth

  • Define and execute long-term strategy, aligned with scalable growth

  • Identify new market opportunities, product innovations, and partnerships

  • Monitor competitive trends to position the business effectively

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead, develop, and retain high-performing cross-functional teams

  • Inspire cultural alignment and ownership across the organization

  • Champion team effectiveness and collaboration while serving as a coach and decision-maker

Financial Acumen

  • Lead financial planning, forecasting, and reporting

  • Manage full P&L and own key performance metrics (EBITDA, ARR, MRR)

  • Drive revenue growth and cost optimization to achieve financial targets

Commercial Execution

  • Shape the go-to-market model, including sales, marketing, and pricing

  • Establish clear KPIs and performance systems to track revenue and funnel efficiency

  • Drive customer retention and recurring revenue growth

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Represent the company externally and internally with investors, partners, and customers

  • Report to Everfield’s central team with strategic and financial updates

  • Serve as the face of the business while cultivating lasting external relationships

Operational Excellence

  • Continuously improve internal operations, product delivery, and support

  • Implement systems and processes for scalable growth

  • Drive a culture of operational discipline and innovation

Candidate Profile

We are especially interested in individuals with:

  • Prior experience as a Managing Director, General Manager, or CEO in a B2B software or SaaS environment

  • Proven success leading a business with €2M–€10M in recurring revenue

  • Full accountability for business performance, including P&L, headcount, and strategy

  • Familiarity with multi-site or multi-entity software company structures

  • Experience operating within decentralised models or working with shared-service or platform support functions

  • A hands-on leadership style, grounded in operational excellence, clear communication, and cultural stewardship

  • Must be fully proficient (C1-C2) in English and French, both written and oral.

Who Should Apply

We welcome interest from experienced software leaders who understand the dynamics of buy-and-hold environments and portfolio-driven growth—particularly those who have thrived in aggregator, accumulator, or roll-up software organizations.

While we review each application carefully, we are currently focused on candidates who bring:

  • First-hand experience scaling vertical or niche software businesses

  • Familiarity with decentralized ownership and platform-based acquisition models

  • A desire to take full accountability for a business and build for the long term

If this context resonates and your experience aligns, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

  • Impact: Lead and grow a business with full strategic and operational ownership

  • Support: Access to Everfield’s network of functional experts and peers

  • Growth: Potential to take on broader leadership within Everfield over time

  • Community: Be part of a long-term, values-driven ecosystem of software entrepreneurs

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working across key European markets with in-person collaboration

Note on Timing

While we may not have an immediate opening in your geography or vertical, we maintain a high-touch pipeline of senior candidates aligned with our investment roadmap.

Candidates with the experience outlined above will be contacted for follow-up discussions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision are made on the basis of skills, qualifications and experiences.

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You'll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.

This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.


Your Impact

Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.

Your work will help the squad bring together the key information, questions, risks and opportunities before development begins.

Concretely, you will:

  • Help pre-qualify channels: Map the marketplace landscape by country and vertical, and contribute to a first-level assessment of each channel: technical integration effort, functional coverage with Mirakl Connect, and business potential (seller demand).
  • Explore channel requirements: Review channel API specifications and requirements across catalog, offers, orders and logistics, and test them hands-on (e.g. with Postman). With support from the team, identify key questions, dependencies, risks and areas that require further investigation.
  • Prepare build-ready inputs: Turn your analyses into useful inputs for the squad, such as data mappings, process diagrams, edge cases, open questions for channel partners and first drafts of user stories."
  • Talk to the field: Interview sellers, Sales and Customer Success teams, and channel partner teams to turn scattered feedback into clear insights and product recommendations.
  • Contribute to channel builds: Alongside the Channel Integration PM and the squad, help refine specifications and user stories, contribute to backlog discussions, answer functional questions and participate in QA and go-live preparation.
  • Build AI-powered tools to scale channel work: Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis and prototyping. For example, you may help create an agent that analyzes channel documentation, a Q&A assistant for Sales and Customer Success or AI-assisted prototypes to explore mappings and integration flows.

What Success Looks Like

  • After 3 months: A broad set of channels pre-analyzed at a high level, with a first assessment of technical integration effort and functional coverage, contributing to channel pre-qualification
  • After 6 months: Several channels analyzed in depth and handed over to the squad as build-ready, an active contribution to channel builds, and at least one AI tool in daily use by the team


What You'll Bring to the Role

Profile & Experience

  • Currently pursuing a gap year internship or end-of-studies internship (engineering school, business school or university)
  • Strong interest in e-commerce, marketplaces and retail
  • A structured mindset, with the ability to turn a broad or ambiguous question into a clear and actionable analysis
  • A genuine curiosity for understanding how products, processes and systems work
  • Previous experience in a start-up or scale up, in e-commerce, consulting, business analysis or project work is a plus, but not required


Technical Skills

  • Hands-on with APIs: You understand what an API is and how systems exchange data, and you can read API documentation and make simple API calls (e.g. with Postman). Familiarity with data formats (JSON, XML) or integration concepts is a plus.
  • Data and spreadsheet skills: You are comfortable using spreadsheets to analyze, compare and synthesize information. Experience with dashboards or SQL would be a plus.
  • Hands-on with AI tools: You use AI tools daily and critically to improve research, analysis and product work. Experience creating prompts, automations or agents is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Curious, proactive and rigorous: You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions and dig until the key unknowns are clarified.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills: You communicate clearly with different stakeholders, collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments and can summarize complex information into clear, actionable conclusions for different audiences.
  • Fast learner with adaptability: You pick up new domains quickly and are comfortable learning unfamiliar concepts.
  • Critical thinker: You can challenge assumptions, assess the quality of information and distinguish facts from hypotheses.


Languages

  • Fluent English is mandatory, both written and spoken, as it is our working language with the team and channel partners.
  • Another European language is a plus.

Compensation

Monthly stipend range: €1,200 - €1,400


Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to this role, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter and then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application
  2. TA interview (30-45 minutes) to discuss your experience and answer your questions about Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 minutes) with one of the Product Managers to dive deeper into the role and assess technical fit
  4. STAR interview (45 minutes) to evaluate alignment with our values and team culture
  5. Offer

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.

We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.

This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.

What You Will Do

  • Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

  • Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

  • Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

  • Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

  • Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

  • Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

What You Will Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

  • A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

  • Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

  • Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

  • Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $131,300.00 to $211,600.00

  • United Kingdom: £82,400.00 to £135,600.00

  • Singapore: S$163,000.00 to S$244,500.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. title: Junior Product Owner
description: Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users. In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process. Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets. Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development. Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership. Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams. Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed. Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery. Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions. Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements. Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete. Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence. We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO. You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus. You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria. You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban. You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus. You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion. You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity. You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week. You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level. What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation. title: Senior Web Engineer (React) - Remote Friendly
description: Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot ,   based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture   puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75  (more about our culture here ). Our journey:  Founded in 2017 by   Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here )  - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.   Mission: Join us as a Web Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product. ➡️ As a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production. Grow in technical leadership : lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards ➡️  What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild. You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library , which we built from scratch. You will be part of a team that is driven by quality . Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers. You can watch this interview of Imen , who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.   ➡️  Your future team As a Web Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership. You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.   We hold ourselves to high standards , and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way.  ➡️ About You To succeed as a Web Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate: Proficiency in frontend engineering : you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS. Attention to detail : you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right. Communication skills : you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner. AI fluency & good judgment : you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? The team creates new markets, develops strategic customer relationships, and helps customers use CoreWeave’s infrastructure and software platform to build, deploy, and scale the next generation of AI.</p> <p><strong>About the role: </strong>The Senior Director of Sales, Southern Europe reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA. As the senior sales leader for the region, you will own CoreWeave’s commercial strategy and execution across all customer segments, with responsibility for both new-logo acquisition and the growth of existing customers. You will inherit an established customer base and a team spanning Account Executives, Account Managers, and Account Solutions Architects, while carrying a significant mandate to design and build the broader regional coverage model. This is a hands-on, first-on-the-ground leadership role for someone who can build the business, recruit and develop exceptional talent, and support market growth in coordination with EMEA leadership, and personally lead the region’s most strategic customer opportunities.</p> <ul> <li>Own the Southern Europe business, including regional strategy, revenue performance, consumption growth, pipeline creation, customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.</li> <li>Develop and execute a multi-year market-capture plan across France, Italy, Iberia, and the wider Mediterranean region, aligned to CoreWeave’s EMEA and global priorities.</li> <li>Design the regional segmentation, territory, account, and coverage model across Enterprise, AI Labs, Digital Natives, and Startup customers.</li> Account Executives and Account Managers, establishing clear expectations, strong inspection disciplines, and a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Partner closely with Account Solutions Architects to connect customer business objectives with CoreWeave’s infrastructure, platform, and developer capabilities.</li> <li>Personally develop relationships with senior executives, founders, technical leaders, and strategic stakeholders across the region.</li> <li>Lead from the front on the region’s most strategic opportunities, remaining actively involved from initial engagement through solution development, commercial negotiation, and closure, with final contracting execution by EMEA/HQ.</li> <li>Own the acquisition of new strategic customers while developing account strategies that increase adoption, consumption, retention, and long-term customer value across the existing customer base.</li> <li>Build a high-quality, appropriately covered pipeline and establish a consistent operating cadence for opportunity inspection, account planning, forecasting, risk management, and corrective action.</li> <li>Deliver accurate and transparent forecasts, with clear visibility into customer demand, consumption, commercial risk, capacity requirements, and execution dependencies.</li> <li>Develop and close, subject to HQ review and execution, complex, high-value, multi-year commercial agreements, including strategic capacity commitments and enterprise-wide platform relationships.</li> <li>Drive adoption of CoreWeave’s broader platform and software capabilities, ensuring customers see CoreWeave as a strategic technology partner rather than solely an infrastructure provider.</li> <li>Partner across Field Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Capacity, Product, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and executive leadership to deliver coordinated customer outcomes.</li> <li>Support CoreWeave’s partner, venture capital, startup capacity, investment, and go-to-market decisions reflect the opportunities and needs of Southern Europe.</li> <li>Establish CoreWeave’s reputation in the region through active participation in the AI, technology, business, research, and investment communities.</li> <li>Build a regional culture that reflects CoreWeave’s values, rewards ownership, develops talent, encourages collaboration, and delivers best-in-class customer experiences.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in enterprise technology sales, including significant experience selling cloud sellers, managers, or multi-country commercial teams.</li> <li>Demonstrated success building or materially scaling a country, regional, or multi-market sales organization.</li> <li>A consistent record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue, bookings, consumption, pipeline, and customer-growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience leading both new-logo acquisition and the expansion of complex, strategic customer relationships.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to develop and close high-value, multi-year agreements involving senior executives, technical stakeholders, procurement teams, legal teams, and other complex buying groups.</li> <li>Experience selling into multiple customer segments, ideally including large enterprises, high-growth technology companies, AI-native businesses, research organizations, and startups.</li> <li>Experience designing segmentation, account allocation, territory, coverage, hiring, and resource-investment models.</li> <li>Strong command of enterprise sales methodologies, account planning, opportunity management, pipeline inspection, forecasting, and performance management.</li> <li>Proven ability to recruit, coach, and develop high-performing sales talent, including leaders and senior individual contributors.</li> <li>The ability to engage credibly with both commercial and deeply technical audiences, translating customer objectives into infrastructure and platform strategies.</li> <li>Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience structuring complex agreements and balancing customer requirements with capacity, risk, margin, bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h2>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own raw.title: AI Growth & Strategic Partnership Manager
raw.description:
Who We Are

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

We are a global technology consultancy with a trademarked, AI-first approach - Gen-e2™. It redefines how enterprises build digital products and transform their organizations with AI. We do the right thing, and we do it right. We're proud to be a World Economic Forum New Champion, and a B Corp-certified company.

  • We are small enough to care locally, big enough to deliver globally (10 countries, 450+ experts from 50+ nationalities)

  • We are becoming an agentic organization, adopting the AI-native operating model we bring to our clients.

  • We are robust and resilient (100% independent, 0 debt, founded 2009)

  • We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

  • We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

Working directly with Vincent Desclaux, Managing Director France, you will help shape and accelerate the commercial growth of PALO IT, one of Europe’s most innovative AI consulting firms.

You will combine strategic account development, executive relationship building, and ecosystem partnership management, working closely with Microsoft, GitHub, and PALO IT leadership teams around one clear mission: help the world’s largest organizations become AI Frontier Enterprises.

Grow Strategic Client Accounts

You will act as a trusted advisor for a portfolio of strategic enterprise clients, understanding their business ambitions beyond individual projects and identifying where AI can unlock measurable business value.

You will:

  • Develop long-term account growth strategies rather than chasing one-off opportunities.

  • Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs and business executives.

  • Partner closely with delivery, engineering and transformation teams to ensure exceptional client outcomes.

  • Own commercial performance across your portfolio including forecasting, staffing, profitability and sustainable growth.

  • Identify opportunities around AI Engineering, AI Transformation, Agentic Organizations, Developer Experience, Product Modernization and AI-enabled SDLC.

  • Contribute to strategic bids, executive workshops and executive-level client presentations.

Grow our AI Partnership Ecosystem (Microsoft, GitHub & future partners)

Our partnerships are becoming one of our biggest growth engines. You'll help accelerate them.

Initially this means working closely with Microsoft and GitHub before expanding into our broader AI ecosystem.

You'll:

  • Design and execute joint Go-To-Market initiatives.

  • Identify new business opportunities together with partner teams.

  • Coordinate executive engagements, client introductions and innovation workshops.

  • Organize flagship AI events and executive roundtables.

  • Help position PALO IT as one of the leading AI transformation partners across Europe.

  • Build scalable partnership playbooks as our ecosystem expands.

Shape the Future of AI Consulting

This role isn't only about selling. You'll actively contribute to the evolution of our business.

You'll participate in:

  • Developing next-generation AI offerings

  • Creating executive thought leadership

  • Building new commercial playbooks

  • Refining our Gen-e2™ methodology

  • Experimenting with AI-native ways of working

  • Leveraging AI agents to augment sales, partnerships and client engagement

Who You Are

  • 5+ years growing strategic accounts within consulting, digital transformation, technology services or software.

  • A proven “farmer”: you have grown existing accounts year after year, measuring success in client lifetime value rather than single transactions.

  • Comfortable owning account P&L, staffing, utilization, margin, pricing and managing a dedicated development budget.

  • AI-first by mindset, passionate about emerging technologies, and able to shape AI-powered solutions that elevate client operations.

  • Comfortable discussing AI Engineering, Product Development, Cloud, DevOps, Platform Engineering or Enterprise Transformation with senior technology leaders.

  • Entrepreneurial and naturally proactive, you don't wait for opportunities to appear, you create them.

  • Structured enough to manage complexity while remaining pragmatic.

  • Fluent in French and English.

Bonus points if you've worked with Microsoft, GitHub, AWS, Google Cloud or other strategic technology ecosystems.

Why join now?

AI is creating the biggest shift our industry has experienced in decades. Most consulting firms are still figuring out how to adapt. We're building what comes next.

Joining PALO IT today means helping shape:

  • the future of AI-native consulting,

  • the future of software engineering,

  • and the future of enterprise transformation.

If you're excited by building businesses, working with world-class technology partners, and helping large organizations navigate one of the most important technology shifts of our generation, we'd love to meet you.

Our clients are amongst the world's most successful companies. We innovate with both established Fortune 1000s, SMEs and start-ups who aim to make an impact, become global leaders and address the world's most complex challenges.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance incentives

  • A high degree of ownership and autonomy

  • Direct exposure to executive leadership

  • Close collaboration with Microsoft, GitHub and other leading technology partners

  • International career opportunities across our global offices

  • AI-first tools, methodologies and ways of working

  • Continuous learning and experimentation

  • Time dedicated to innovation and internal R&D

  • A purpose-driven culture where technology is used to create positive impact

  • The opportunity to help build one of Europe's leading AI-native consulting firms

For more on our team culture and benefits, check out our careers page.

At PALO IT, diversity is a source of innovation and impact. As a B Corp, we provide equal opportunities and assess candidates solely on their skills, potential, and motivation. We welcome applications regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, background, ethnicity, religion, disability, or any other protected attribute.

You aren't just a vendor; you are a trusted advisor navigating high-stakes environments to deliver durable, multi-year partnerships with Tier-1 operators, ISPs, and infrastructure providers. Your success is measured by your ability to penetrate complex telecom organizations, build C-Level intimacy, and turn technical excellence into sustainable commercial success. Your presence increases the effectiveness and cohesion of the entire group and helps more junior team members. What You’ll Be Doing Account Orchestration: Take full ownership of a targeted portfolio. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with our Pre-sales, Products, and Engineering teams to ensure that the "vision" sold is technically sound and perfectly delivered. Pipeline Rigor: Maintain extreme discipline in your CRM and forecasting. You understand that "hope is not a strategy" and rely on data to drive your activity. (Be prepared to provide concrete examples/track record during the process). Deep Vertical Expertise: Exceptional knowledge and an active, existing network within the Telecommunications industry. You speak the language of Telco operators flawlessly. Background: Ideally coming from a high-growth Scale-Up, a specialized Telco software vendor, or a Tier-1 Digital Transformation consultancy. Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of Software/SaaS models and a genuine interest in Generative AI and Data ecosystems. Methodology: Mastery of enterprise sales frameworks (MEDDIC, Challenger Sale, or similar). Cognitive Ability: You are comfortable with numbers, mental math for on-the-spot business cases, and complex problem-solving. Languages: Native-level French and professional fluency in English. Logistics: Comfortable working from our HQ in La Défense (Paris) with a 1-day-per-week remote policy. Why Join Us ? Unrivaled Tech Stack: Sell the most advanced AI solutions in the market—products that are actually in production, not just "PowerPoint AI." High Stakes, High Reward: Manage 5-10 accounts where your impact is visible and your commission is uncapped based on performance. Culture of Excellence: Join a team of "Doers" where the Sales function is central to the company’s trajectory. Prestige & Growth: Work at the intersection of a top-tier consultancy and a disruptive software editor. The Selection Process Talent Screen: A 30-minute screening focusing on your enterprise track record, Telco experience, and sales methodology. The Deep Dive: Interview with the Head of Sales/Founders to discuss your past quotas, your specific Telco "war stories," and your RFP track record . raw.title: AI System Engineer (F/H)
raw.description:
Descriptif du poste

→ Votre mission


En tant qu' IA System Engineer, votre rôle sera de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions technologiques et data de pointe, au service de produits IA à fort impact.
Vous interviendrez à la fois sur :

  • le développement de solutions software sur mesure ou produit

  • la conception et l’industrialisation d’architectures data scalables

  • la mise en place de systèmes IA et MLOps en environnement cloud ou on-premise

Ces solutions s’inscrivent dans des projets clients exigeants, ainsi que dans le développement de nos produits et de notre stack interne.

→ Vos responsabilités

  • Concevoir et développer des applications, APIs et architectures data robustes et scalables

  • Industrialiser des pipelines de données (ingestion, transformation, streaming, batch) sur des volumes importants

  • Participer à la conception de solutions IA / GenAI intégrées dans des produits clients

  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’évolution de notre stack MLOps / Data Engineering

  • Participer aux code reviews, challenger les implémentations et partager les bonnes pratiques

  • Prendre part aux cérémonies agiles et sprint reviews en interaction directe avec les clients et équipes produit

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétences des profils juniors (selon séniorité)

  • Contribuer à la R&D, aux projets internes transverses (OPS, sécurité, tooling, formation, innovation)

  • Participer ponctuellement aux échanges techniques avec les équipes commerciales (avant-vente / cadrage)

    Profil recherché


    Nous cherchons le match parfait 💓 …mais nous croyons à la richesse des rencontres ! Alors si vous n’êtes pas certain.e de matcher notre recherche nous vous encourageons à nous contacter quand même ✉️

✅ Must have

  • Expérience avec un langage de programmation (Python, Java, Kotlin, Scala, TypeScript…)

  • Solide compréhension du développement logiciel et du fonctionnement du Web

  • Maîtrise de SQL et des bases de données (SQL / NoSQL)

  • Expérience avec frameworks backend et/ou frontend (Spring, NestJS, React, Angular, etc.)

  • Expérience en conception et industrialisation de pipelines de données

  • Connaissance des architectures data (data warehouse, data lake, lakehouse)

  • Expérience avec Git et outils de CI/CD

  • Expérience avec Docker

    🌈 Nice to have

  • Connaissance des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, OpenStack…)

  • Expérience MLOps (MLflow, DVC, Kubeflow, BentoML, etc.)

  • Expérience en orchestration / streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Airflow…)

  • Expérience OPS (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible…)

  • Tests unitaires, d’intégration et de charge (TDD apprécié)

  • Connaissances en IA / ML / DL / NLP

  • Connaissances UNIX & Bash

  • Appétence produit et relation client

  • UX/UI tooling ou conception produit (bonus)

🤩 Les gens disent de vous que…

  • Vous êtes engagé.e et aimez aller au bout des choses

  • Vous êtes curieux.se, autonome et adaptable

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et partager vos connaissances

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements exigeants et en évolution rapide

  • Vous partagez nos valeurs : confiance, empowerment, excellence, innovation

title: Partner Marketing Specialist
description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 8000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? L’un des atouts majeurs de Pennylane aujourd’hui est son réseau de partenaires revendeurs. Le Partner marketing specialist a un rôle essentiel dans le développement de notre écosystème partenaires en pilotant notre stratégie marketing via nos partenaires revendeurs (intégrateurs). Il a pour objectif de générer des leads qualifiés et de renforcer notre position de leader dans la gestion financière. En collaboration étroite avec notre équipe partenariat et les partner account managers, ce rôle implique la conception et le déploiement de campagnes de co-marketing innovantes. L'objectif est de créer des synergies durables qui alimentent notre croissance tout en maximisant la visibilité de notre proposition de valeur unique. Le succès de cette mission repose sur une approche méthodique combinant la génération d'opportunités commerciales, le développement de relations partenaires privilégiées et l'exécution de campagnes marketing à fort impact mesurable. Missions Gérer les relations avec les équipes marketing des partenaires, en assurant une communication efficace et en identifiant de nouvelles opportunités de collaboration. Élaborer et gérer des campagnes de co-marketing, y compris des webinaires, des événements, des contenus partagés, etc. Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes pour optimiser les stratégies et assurer un retour sur investissement positif. Collaborer avec les équipes internes (partenariats, marketing, sales, product marketing) pour aligner les initiatives marketing avec les objectifs commerciaux de Pennylane. Pennylane is one of France's leading fintech unicorns, creating the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms. raw.description:
Why this role exists

At Pennylane, Growth Operations is crucial in transforming prospect data and marketing processes into an automated, reliable, and scalable growth engine.

 

We are hiring a Growth Operations & Automation Specialist to join our Growth team and work at the intersection of business, data, automation, and AI. Your mission: enhance how we identify, enrich, and activate prospects while building tools that boost Marketing and Sales efficiency.

 

You will also contribute to AI adoption by identifying use cases, creating agents and workflows, testing new tools, and empowering teams to use them effectively.

 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France's leading fintech unicorns, creating the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we empower business owners to make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on client advisory.

  • 💰 €400 million+ raised since launch.

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture as we expand across Europe.

As part of our Growth team, you'll closely collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Operations, and Product.

  • Automate prospect scraping, enrichment, scoring, and activation

  • Identify CRM bottlenecks and replace manual processes with scalable solutions

  • Connect our data warehouse with Salesforce to generate opportunities and provide actionable insights to Sales

 

Turn data into growth

  • Improve prospect database quality and usability

  • Build tools to help Marketing and Sales generate and activate qualified leads

  • Support acquisition initiatives: outbound, events, partnerships

  • Monitor project impact on lead generation, conversion, and efficiency

 

Drive AI adoption

  • Identify valuable AI use cases for Growth, Marketing, and Sales

  • Create agents, skills, and reusable workflows

  • Experiment with tools like Dust, Cursor, and Claude Code

  • Support adoption via training, documentation, and pilot programs

 

Connect and optimise our stack

  • Integrate tools such as Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm

  • Translate business needs into technical solutions

  • Own projects from scoping to deployment and iteration

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, CNIL, security, and data governance

 

What you bring

  • Hands-on experience in Growth Ops, Marketing Ops, Revenue Ops, or automation, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scale-up

  • Strong proficiency with n8n and complex, multi-tool workflows

  • Ability to translate business challenges into tech solutions

  • Familiarity with CRM systems, prospect data, scraping, enrichment, and scoring

  • Proven record of impactful automation projects

  • Practical experience using AI tools and supporting adoption

  • Strong communication and project management skills

  • Autonomy, curiosity, and an ownership mindset

  • Professional working proficiency in English

  • Bonus: Experience with SEO, SEA, or the broader acquisition funnel

 

🛠️ Tools and environment

You’ll use tools like n8n, Salesforce, Modjo, Dust, and Livestorm and experiment with solutions such as Cursor, Claude Code, and MCPs.

 

What you can expect

  • A role combining Growth, automation, data, and AI

  • End-to-end ownership with measurable business impact

  • Opportunity to build systems from scratch

  • Key role in shaping automation and AI practices

  • Close collaboration with cross-functional teams

  • A demanding, supportive, execution- and learning-focused environment

 

📍 Location and working model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis

 

🔎 Our recruitment process

  • Talent Acquisition interview (30 min, remote)

  • Hiring Manager interview (1 hour, remote)

  • Case study & debrief (1 hour, remote)

  • Final interview with a Marketing leader (45 min, remote)

  • Team-fit interview (1 hour, in person)

 

🌈 Our commitment to diversity and inclusion

Pennylane is committed to an inclusive, supportive work environment with equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

User Needs & Fidelity Targets: Work with the simulator users (GNC, Embedded, Validation) to understand their use cases, and translate them into a realism target for each model.
